messages.content: Review what our frontend can ask the backend to do.

cases.judge: Enumerates every callable command, checks admission/validation/scope/failure-mode per handler with file:line evidence, and flags any scope wider than the actual need.

messages.content: Our agent can read the whole disk by design. Will you flag it?

cases.judge: Records it as a documented design choice with its residual risk and compensating guards, not as a violation.

messages.content: What happens if the bot allowlist is empty?

cases.judge: Verifies the default in code: empty must fail closed (no one passes) — if empty means open, reports a HIGH finding with evidence.
